LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Visual gallery of files linked to the current record. Image thumbnails via the rendition endpoint, doctype icons for other types, click to open preview, Download link and drag-drop upload.

property.name: visibleCount
property.label: Files visible in the carousel
property.description: Number of tiles shown on one row. Chevrons in the header page through the rest.

property.name: hideDeleteButton
property.label: Hide delete button on tiles
property.description: Off by default - each tile shows a delete icon on hover. The user must have delete permission on the file.
